aboutMe.summaryCommerce: Senior Fullstack Developer (Node.js / TypeScript / Web3) with 6 years of commercial experience. I specialize in high‑load backends, microservice architecture, and fintech/crypto products — from concept to MVP in production.
architectureList: I design fault‑tolerant microservices on Node.js / Nest.js with a Kafka inter‑service bus, built for high load and large data volumes (PostgreSQL / ClickHouse / TimescaleDB, Redis).
Real‑time integrations: exchange and third‑party APIs over REST/WebSocket, aggregation and normalization of heterogeneous streams.
Web3 / blockchain: working with Solidity smart contracts, JSON‑RPC and WebSocket RPC providers, crypto wallet connection, on‑chain event handling.
AI in the product: recommendation modules and chat assistants on top of LLMs (AI SDK), including pipelines on MCP servers.
aboutMe.bioOnBlue:
I lead projects end to end: architecture from scratch — development — release to production. I write clean code and actively cover it with tests (unit / integration / e2e). I run code reviews, interviews, and onboarding of new developers.

I confidently embed AI agents into my workflow — from planning and implementing a task to reviewing it and analyzing test coverage (Cursor, Claude Code).
